ABOUT THE TRUST

Care that starts with community.

KARUNA AJN medical trust brings community eye care, practical guidance, and a responsible view of impact together in one place.

WHY WE ARE HERE

Everyone deserves the chance to see clearly.

KARUNA AJN medical trust is a charitable eye-care trust focused on bringing screening closer to communities. The aim is to make a first step easier to take, explain what comes next, and help people stay connected to care.

Verified details about the trust’s history, team, registration, and service locations will be added as they are confirmed.

OUR WORK

Care beyond the screening.

A connected approach gives people clearer guidance from their first eye check to the next step in care.

01

Screen with care

Community eye camps provide an accessible place to begin understanding eye health.

02

Guide the next step

Clear explanations and referrals can help people find appropriate further assessment.

03

Stay connected

Thoughtful follow-ups can support people as they continue their care journey.

◎

OUR IMPACT

Every person matters. Every story deserves privacy.

The trust plans to share reviewed, anonymous summaries of its community work. Personal details and health records will stay within the secure staff portal. Verified measures will be added once they are ready to publish responsibly.
